title: Dennis Haskins, US actor who played Mr Belding in Saved by the Bell, dies aged 75
summary_full: Agent calls death of Haskins, who played the school principal in three programs, ‘a tragic loss’The US actor Dennis Haskins – most known for co-starring in the popular Saved by the Bell television series franchise – has died, his agent confirmed on Tuesday. He was 75.Alluding to Haskins’ Saved by the Bell character, the fictional high school principal Mr Richard Belding, agent Jay Schachter said in a statement: “It’s a tragic loss. Everyone loved Mr Belding, and those of us who got to know Dennis loved him even more. Continue reading...
